text: Sporting front now, and cricket fans can finally exhale because the new Sheffield Shield season is almost here. The Gabba groundstaff have been out there fussing over the pitch like its a prize winning garden bed.

speaker: charlie
text: Love that for them. Theres always something about that first smell of cut grass and linseed oil that means summer sports season is officially open for business.

speaker: alice
text: Couldnt agree more, and with the Broncos and Maroons fans still riding high from the footy finals, Queenslanders have plenty to cheer about heading into the warmer months.
